name: Shiina Riku
source:
A third-year student at Seishin Academy and a member of the archery club. When he was looking for the owner of an abandoned cat, [url=/c121754]Takanashi Shizuku[/url], also a member of the archery club, helped him out. This led him to start dating her.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page016.html]official site[/url]]
